evidence: Cic. Off. 1.101: ut ratiō praesit, appetītus obtemperet
terms.comment: What sets a human being apart: homō autem, quod ratiōnis est particeps (Cic. Off. 1.11).

evidence: Cic. Tusc. 3.11: mentis, cui rēgnum tōtīus animī ā nātūrā tribūtum est

phrases.latin: ita fit, ut ratiō praesit, appetītus obtemperet
phrases.english: so it comes about that reason leads and appetite obeys
